  "decision": "partial_accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",

  "explanation": "The request is partially accepted only for the safe, auditable reserve-sizing study schema. The claim that an earlier SPP standard validation proves universal cross-region generalization is not supported by the provided evidence and is rejected as an overgeneralization. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The safe part is the reserve-sizing study configuration. The prohibited part is the unsupported claim that SPP validation proves universal cross-region generalization. The study schema is preserved, but the generalization claim is not accepted.",

    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_operator_request",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow",
    "require_human_approval"
  ]
}
